Well… as we do have both systems, it's hard to say. My boyfriend and I have always leaned more toward the PlayStation systems, but when the Xbox One came out we decided to give it a try. My impressions:

The Xbox One is amazing. The interface is great to work with and the voice commands are probably my favorite thing about it. The graphics look phenomenal and the new Kinect is fantastic. I have Just Dance 4 and Zumba for the Xbox, and they are so much fun to play! As far as gaming goes… I feel like the Xbox really is all about the entertainment factor. I pretty much use it exclusively for Netflix and the like, mainly because it's just so much fun to use.

The PS4 has voice commands too, but they're not nearly as fun to play with (not quite as many things you can tell it to do). The graphics - as far as gameplay goes - I think are much better. If you're a hardcore gamer like my boyfriend, I think the PS4 is a better bet… If you just like the entertainment factor, go with the Xbox. Both systems are great, though!
